goal: Add the smallest framework-neutral StandardRouter in the delivery ring: it dispatches a plain HTTP-like message to a registered plain handler by exact method+path match, with no dependency on any HTTP server or framework. It is the stable route-selection surface a future ASGI/Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI host can call; it does not select any host.
nonGoals: no HTTP server of any kind
no Postgres, db or schema change
no CI, package.json or dependency change
no release, deploy, readiness or product-runnable claim
no change to src/adapters, src/application or src/sdk
no host selection of any kind

standardRefs.reason: Standard Router obligation itself: this package is the router; the matrix below reports its own applicability instead of pasting SR text.

Known FastAPI-family drift (ASGI Core Profile / Uvicorn / Hypercorn / FastAPI optional adapter): business rules cannot bind to FastAPI. Router satisfies the negative half only — no ASGI/Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI import or coupling anywhere in this module; it does not itself implement the ASGI Core Profile or any adapter, which stays a future, separately scoped host package.
standardRefs.consumer: future ASGI Core Profile host (not built here)

standardRefs.reason: Deterministic mutation chain ActionSpec->PDP->invariants->ChangeSet->UoW->audit/outbox->CommitReceipt is not touched: StandardRouter only matches method+path and calls a handler once; it builds no ActionSpec, calls no PDP, and performs no mutation or commit. That chain belongs to downstream handlers such as CreateCustomerRequestHandler.
standardRefs.canonicalSource: n/a — no mutation code in this module
standardRefs.waiver: not applicable; router is upstream of the chain, not a participant

standardRefs.reason: Tenant isolation is not enforced or read here: the router's message shape is only { method, path }, with no tenantId field parsed, validated or compared. Tenant isolation is downstream handler and PDP responsibility.
standardRefs.canonicalSource: n/a — no tenant field in this module
standardRefs.evidence: route dispatch keys only on method+path; message shape check does not read tenantId
standardRefs.waiver: not applicable; router performs no tenant-scoped operation

standardRefs.reason: Authorization / PDP / PEP is not performed here: the router makes no allow/deny decision and calls the matched handler unconditionally once matched. Enforcement point authority stays with downstream handlers (e.g. CreateCustomerRequestHandler -> PolicyDecisionPoint).
standardRefs.canonicalSource: n/a — no authorization code in this module
standardRefs.evidence: handle() has no PDP/PEP call; only 400/404/405/handler-dispatch branches
standardRefs.waiver: not applicable; router is not an enforcement point

userJourney.before: Delivery ring'de CreateCustomer isteğini işleyen bir handler vardı, ama birden çok yol/metod kombinasyonunu tek bir giriş noktasına yönlendirecek genel bir yönlendirici yoktu.
userJourney.after: StandardRouter sıradan { method, path } mesajlarını kayıtlı handler'lara tam bir kez yönlendiriyor; bozuk mesaj 400, bilinmeyen yol 404, desteklenmeyen metod 405. Hâlâ hiçbir HTTP sunucusu çalışmıyor — bu paket yalnızca yol seçim yüzeyinin şeklini kanıtlıyor.
userJourney.note: Bu paketle hiçbir sunucu veya framework çalışır hale gelmiyor.

kalanEngel: hiçbir HTTP/ASGI host bu yönlendiriciyi henüz çağırmıyor; sunucu bağlama ayrı, kapsamı belirlenecek bir paket.
